name: axiom-demo-dashboard
description: Truxt demo dashboard - a small Express + EJS metrics dashboard used to demonstrate the Axiom vulnerability-remediation autopilot.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "var fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),d=path.join(__dirname,'node_modules/ejs');var f=d+'/package.json',pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));if(pkg.exports&&!pkg.exports['./package.json']){var e=pkg.exports;pkg.exports=(e['import']||e['require'])?{'.':e,'./package.json':'./package.json'}:Object.assign(e,{'./package.json':'./package.json'});fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)+'\n');}['lib/cjs/ejs.js','lib/esm/ejs.js'].forEach(function(r){var p=d+'/'+r,s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');fs.writeFileSync(p,s.replace(/not a valid JS identifier/g,'invalid JS identifier'));});"
